_comment: Per-run payouts of the generic dungeon runner. 'battles' is indexed by the order in which a run's battles are won (1st win, 2nd win, ...; the last entry repeats), 'boss' is the finale room's battle, which also grants the dungeon's pack from 'packs' (DungeonTemplate name -> chest template GUID). A dungeon entry may override 'battles'/'boss'. Castle Crayburn has its own runner and is not affected.
